seen_animation: a.png: In frame 1 a black-lined rounded rectangle with wandering inner lines (a drawn map or aerial photo) sits low in the centre of the frame, tilted about 35 degrees and foreshortened into a diamond shape, between two grey head-and-shoulders figures, with grey river lines across the top. In frames 2-3 it rises and rotates toward level while growing wider. In frame 4 it is almost level, at upper centre between the two heads. From frame 5 to 16 it sits level at the same spot between the two heads and holds there, with only small redraw variation in the inner lines.
seen_film: d.png: Two men stand in front of a wall map of rivers. In frame 1 the man on the left holds a tilted aerial photograph low in the centre. In frames 2-4 he lifts it and turns it level, pressing it against the map between the two men. From frame 5 he holds it in place with his left hand and points into it with his right; the man on the right points at it too (frame 6). Frames 7-11 the left man keeps pointing at spots in the photo. In frames 12-13 he turns to look at the other man while holding the photo. In frames 14-16 both men point at it and their hands cross over it; the photo stays in place, shifting only slightly.
named_subject: the aerial photograph / map print that the man lifts and holds against the wall map

closes_when: In e.png 46-56 the drawing shifts a few pixels right and slightly tilts or settles back, in step with the film's frames where the second man's hand presses on the photo.
protect: The doodle's construction (rounded-rectangle outline with the left vertical branch, the curved upper-right loop, the small knot at centre and the two hanging lines) kept intact through the rotation; the matched lift-and-level timing in frames 1-9; the rest position between the two heads; the clean single path in g.png with no jumps.
